Although recent indicators still point to solid growth and low unemployment, the latest Financial Stability Report highlights persistent vulnerabilities—elevated asset valuations, ongoing commercial real estate pressures (as of Q4 2024), rising delinquencies in some consumer credit, run-prone short-term funding in prime money market funds and stablecoins, and bouts of Treasury market liquidity strain—warranting a slightly more cautious tone than the initial assessment.
